triple_assay_candidates.finding: The original study describes parallel sci-RNA, sci-ATAC and sci-Hi-C assays and computational integration; same-cell three-assay pairing is not established.
The study describes same-cell RNA/ATAC multiome but Hi-C prepared from a bulk population, not same-cell contact measurements.

limitations: The database catalog describes candidate networks, not necessarily causal or independently measured direct regulatory edges.
No candidate network was used for training or evaluation in this screening.
Original network provenance, redistribution and usage rights, and overlap with frozen evaluation data remain to be established.
The listed catalog edge counts have not been independently verified by fully downloading the source networks.
The absence of confirmed three-assay pairing does not disqualify an appropriate separately labelled auxiliary use.
